prompt:
Create a 3x1 sprite sheet for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG: one MONSTER in three battle poses.

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: three cells on white. In each cell the light-grey box shows where the monster stands and how big it is, the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the monster faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Draw the SAME monster once in every cell, filling its box. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, flat shading with 2-3 tones per colour and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero; it is a different character.

Image 3 is an APPROVED MONSTER sheet from this same game (a DIFFERENT monster, idle | attack | hurt): match its sprite-pixel size, rendering, shading, outline weight and level of detail, and how much the poses move. Do NOT copy that monster's body, colours or equipment.

Render as true pixel art: the monster about 96-120 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients.

Monster: a green wyvern standing upright like a big bird on only two strong clawed hind legs, the body tilted up, no front legs or arms at all: its two large leathery green bat wings (exactly two) grow from the shoulders and fold at its sides with a small claw at each wing joint, a long neck and a horned reptile head with yellow eyes, a long tail ending in a big dark arrow-shaped barbed stinger curled up behind it; the whole wyvern, wing tips and tail included, sits in the middle of its own cell with empty space on both sides. Keep every detail identical in every cell. FACE: its horned reptile head with yellow eyes is readable.

Cells:
- left cell: idle, a ready battle stance facing right.
- middle cell: attack, the neck stretched forward with the jaws open at the heroes and the stinger tail arched over its back, the wings raised, both feet on the ground, the head and stinger well inside the middle cell, facing right.
- right cell: hurt, knocked back, the wings flared, the neck twisted back, both feet on the ground, recoiling away from the heroes (leaning left), still facing right.

MOVEMENT: the attack and hurt cells are dramatic ACTION frames, not static stances. Use a strong diagonal line of action through the whole body: stretch the neck, beak or jaws far forward, flare or fold the wings, and counter-swing the tail. Each of the three silhouettes must be clearly different. BODY: in every cell, standing on two feet, both feet on the ground line. No mist, smoke or ground effects.

One monster per cell and nothing else: no props on the ground, no effects outside the monster, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no floor, no shadows, no borders.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, front legs, four legs, a rider, fire breath, a third wing, feathers, rearing up.
